topic: 教育与已发生的变化 · Independent new scenario: learners discussing evidence about a study method
grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Study Methods and Changes: A Library Conversation
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题，也不代表任何正式分数。请先听/读对话，注意现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）与一般过去时的区别，以及 already / yet / since / for 的用法。完成 8 道听力/阅读题后，学习语法讲解并做 8 道语法题。所有题目选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look happy. Have you finished your study project yet?
Ben: Yes, I have. I finished it on Monday. I have already sent it to our teacher.
Mia: Great. I haven't started my part yet. I'm a little worried.
Ben: Don't worry. I have used a new study method for two weeks. It really helps.
Mia: Really? What method?
Ben: I have studied in short blocks since the beginning of this month. Twenty minutes of work, then a five-minute break.
Mia: That sounds simple. Have you tried it for math?
Ben: Yes, I have. I did math for three blocks yesterday. I also made flashcards for new words.
Mia: I tried flashcards last year, but I stopped after one week. They didn't work for me.
Ben: Maybe you used too many cards. I have made only ten cards so far. I review them every evening.
Mia: That's a good idea. Have you told our teacher about this method?
Ben: No, I haven't told her yet. But I have written a short report. I finished it last night.
Mia: Can I read it? I have never read a student report about study methods.
Ben: Sure. I have just printed a copy. Here you are.
Mia: Thanks. I have already learned something new from this conversation.
Ben: Me too. I have not used my phone during study time for five days. That has helped a lot.

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示“到现在为止已经发生或未发生的事”，结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还（没）”或“已经（吗）”；since 后接时间点（如 since Monday），for 后接时间段（如 for two weeks）。一般过去时只说明过去某个时间发生的事，常与明确过去时间连用（如 yesterday, last year, on Monday）。比较：I finished it on Monday.（过去具体时间） vs. I have finished it.（现在完成，强调结果）。注意：have/has 不随主语的人称变化而改变过去分词形式。
grammar.example: I have used a new study method for two weeks.

questions.explanation: already 常用于现在完成时肯定句，结构 have + 过去分词，所以选 have finished。
questions.evidence: I have already sent it to our teacher.

questions.explanation: yesterday 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 went。
yet 用于否定句，表示“还没有”，用现在完成时 haven't eaten。
questions.evidence: I haven't started my part yet.
I have studied in short blocks since the beginning of this month.

questions.prompt: We have known each other ______ five years.
questions.explanation: five years 是时间段，用 for。
questions.evidence: I have used a new study method for two weeks.

questions.explanation: ever 常用于现在完成时疑问句，结构 Have + 主语 + 过去分词，所以选 Have / ridden。
questions.evidence: Have you tried it for math?

questions.explanation: last night 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 watched。

questions.prompt: She ______ her keys, so she can't open the door.
questions.explanation: 强调过去动作对现在的影响（现在打不开门），用现在完成时 has lost。
questions.evidence: I have not used my phone during study time for five days. That has helped a lot.

part1: Do you like studying alone or with friends?
How often do you review your notes?

speaking.part2: Describe a study method you have tried. You should say: what the method is; when you started it; how long you have used it; and explain why you like or dislike it.
part3: Why do some students study in short blocks?
How has technology changed the way students study?
Should teachers give students more breaks?

transfer.writing: Write a short message (about 80–100 words) to a friend about a new study method you have tried. Say what it is, how long you have used it, what you have already done, and what you haven't done yet.
